title: Every way into the launch lands on /launch

source.ref: Daniel's ruling: nobody leaves the 12-minute flow until launched; one destination, /launch

detail: lib/launch/destination.ts is the one helper (launchHomeHref, inFlowHref, spotlightArrivalGoesHome). /launch/start, /launch/claim, /launch/resume, the launch box pill, /spaces/new (when a launch is under way) and a cold /launch/step/spotlight arrival all land on /launch; /launch starts the launch when a signed-in owner has none, carrying the held niche and intents, so it is never a dead end. Links inside the flow carry go=1 so the step opens rather than bouncing. The pending-launch hold (lib/launch/pending.ts) is read, not changed. The Space console nudge and the come-back email do not exist in the tree yet: they call launchHomeHref({ signedIn: true, lid }). /create-a-space is another thread's: its sign-in return should use the same helper.

verify.note: Helper behaviour under node plus the entries' source: each asks the helper, /launch starts a launch, the flow links are marked, the hold's contract is intact.
